model.fl.stg_payments.name: stg_payments
model.fl.stg_payments.compiled_code: select 1 as payment_id, 1 as order_id, 'credit_card' as payment_method, 10 as amount

model.fl.orders.name: orders
model.fl.orders.compiled_code:
with order_payments as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'credit_card' then amount else 0 end) as credit_card_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'coupon' then amount else 0 end) as coupon_amount,
        sum(amount) as total_amount
    from "db"."main"."stg_payments"
    group by order_id
)
select
    order_id,
    credit_card_amount,
    coupon_amount,
    total_amount
from order_payments
